name: prompt-readiness-gate
description: Deterministic first-turn prompt validation for machine-learning research and coding tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Validate ML prompts before an agent starts work.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic, line-addressed readiness gate for the first structured machine-learning research or coding prompt. It checks grammar completeness, typed constraints, contradictions, unresolved high-impact choices, and acceptance-to-evidence mappings without using an LLM as the test oracle.
defaultPrompt: Use $prompt-readiness-gate to validate my first-turn ML task prompt.
Check this ML experiment prompt for contradictions before execution.
Explain the line-addressed readiness errors in this ML prompt.
